body:
The Build tab milestone needs proof that a supported imported project builds to a deployable that runs. It may already work; this checks it.

- Import a small Gleam project and a small one-crate Rust package into Solace, each on its own, outside Solace's own workspace.
- Build each from the Build tab, using its default recipe or a declared one.
- Copy each deployable out and run it on Linux, with only the runtime it needs (e.g. Erlang for Gleam).

Report what worked and what didn't. For each failure, propose a task to fix it. Change no code here.

Done when: both projects have been tried, and the report says for each whether it built, whether its deployable ran, and which fix tasks were proposed.
title: Investigate imported projects build and run
